spans.s: लञ्चा लञ्चा, f. a present, bribe.

लञ्छन लञ्छन, Eleusine Coracana (a
kind of grain).

लाञ्छन, अम्, n. a mark, sign, token, spot; a
landmark; a mark of ignominy, stain, spot; a name,
appellation.

लञ्ज् 1. लञ्ज् (= rt. 2. लज्), cl. 1. P. लञ्-
जति, &c., to fry, roast; to calumniate,
blame.

लञ्ज् 2. लञ्ज् (also read लुञ्ज्), cl. 10. P.
लञ्जयति, &c., to be strong; to strike,
injure; to dwell; to give; to speak; to shine; to
be manifest.

लञ्जिका, f. a harlot, prostitute; [cf. perhaps Gr.
λαγ-αρό-ς,λάγ-νο-ς, Lat. langu-e-o,
langu-i-du-s, langu-or, laxus, lac-tes.]

लाञ्छ् लाञ्छ् (connected with rt. लक्ष्,
from which it is probably corrupted;
cf. rt. लछ्), cl. 1. P. लाञ्छति, ललाञ्छ, &c., to
mark, distinguish, decorate, deck.

लाञ्छित, अस्, आ, अम्, marked, distinguished, cha-
racterized, designated; decorated, decked; furnished
with (with inst. or at the end of a comp.).
